settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: How this copy of career-mode is set up on this computer.
settings.config.title: Configuration
settings.config.description: Kept in the `.env` file in the project folder, which is never committed, except the picture, which goes to `profile/` (git ignores it too). A variable exported in the shell wins over this file. The port is set with `PORT` in that file.
settings.hint.secret: To remove it, show it with the eye, clear it and save.
settings.savedRestart: Saved. Restart the server (`./stop.sh`, then `./run-local.sh`) for the port or database change to apply.
settings.picture.hint: A PNG or JPEG of up to {mb} MB, kept in `profile/` (git ignores it). It is uploaded right away, no Save needed. Used by the `/submit-profile` skill when a profile picture is needed.
settings.picture.tooBig: The photo is too big ({mb} MB at most).
settings.var.APP_LANGUAGE.label: Language
settings.var.APP_LANGUAGE.description: The language of the app: `en` (English) or `es` (Spanish). It applies when the page reloads.
settings.var.CV_PDF_PATH.label: CV file
settings.var.CV_PDF_PATH.description: The path to your CV as a PDF of up to 1 MB on this computer. `/setup` copies it to `profile/cv.pdf` and fills this in; run it again when your CV changes. A relative path starts at the project folder. The skills attach and upload this file, and `/read-cv` reads it.
settings.var.EMAIL_ADDRESS.label: Email address
settings.var.EMAIL_ADDRESS.description: The address the application emails are sent from (the skills send through it, with no browser). It works with any provider that has an SMTP server: Gmail by default, or set `EMAIL_SMTP_HOST` for another one.
settings.var.EMAIL_PASSWORD.label: Email password
settings.var.EMAIL_PASSWORD.description: The password to send with. Gmail needs an app password, not the account one (Google account, Security, 2-Step Verification, App passwords; spaces are ignored); other providers say which they want.
settings.var.EMAIL_SMTP_HOST.label: SMTP server
settings.var.EMAIL_SMTP_HOST.description: The provider's outgoing mail server. Gmail's is the default.
settings.var.EMAIL_SMTP_PORT.label: SMTP port
settings.var.EMAIL_SMTP_PORT.description: The server's port: 465 (secure from the start) or 587 (STARTTLS).
settings.var.GEMINI_API_KEY.label: Gemini API key
settings.var.GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Used to generate the image of a thought reflection.
settings.var.GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ID.label: Google Calendar ID
settings.var.GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ID.descript: What the Google Calendar button of the Calendar reads. Either the ID of your calendar (Google Calendar, Settings, your calendar, Integrate calendar), which has to be public with "See all event details", or its secret address in iCal format, which also works for a private one.
settings.var.GOOGLE_TASKS_CLIENT_ID.desc: What the Google Tasks button reads: it queues the links of your open tasks and marks those tasks as done. In the Google Cloud Console enable the Google Tasks API, set up the OAuth consent screen (add yourself as a test user) and create an OAuth client ID of type Web application, with https://developers.google.com/oauthplayground as an authorized redirect URI. This is its client ID.
The secret of that OAuth client.
In the OAuth Playground (https://developers.google.com/oauthplayground), open its settings, tick "Use your own OAuth credentials" and paste the client ID and secret above. Write the scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/tasks, authorize, press "Exchange authorization code for tokens" and paste the refresh token here. While the consent screen is in Testing, Google expires it after 7 days: publish the app to keep it.
